$comment: Rush Royale unit reference, rendered by rushroyale.js on units.html. Entries come from two tiers and the difference matters. TIER 1, player-verified: no 'source' field, no 'detail' flag. Transcribed from ability text supplied by a player, so the numbers are real - do not add, round or 'tidy' any figure that did not come from that text. TIER 2, wiki-imported: carries source='fandom-wiki' and sourceRevision, and is flagged detail='stub' so the card renders a 'Needs numbers' line. These were imported from the Fandom wiki, which is community-edited and largely stale (77% of its pages were last touched in 2021-2022); treat every figure in them as unconfirmed until someone checks it in-game. TIER 3, official patch notes: carries source='patch-notes' and sourceRevision set to the update's release date, and is flagged detail='stub' because the notes describe mechanics without giving figures. This tier is more trustworthy than the wiki and less than tier 1 - the developers wrote it, but nobody has checked it against the running game, and where the notes are silent (a faction, a number) the entry says so rather than guessing. When a tier-2 or tier-3 entry is verified, drop 'source', 'sourceRevision' and 'detail'. Fields: name, id (anchor slug), rarity, faction, role (unit type), damage (omit when unstated), summary, abilities (ordered paragraphs), notes, tags (search only). Authored order is alphabetical within a rarity block.

entries.name: Banshee
entries.summary: Only works on a tile touching the path. Idle Banshees feed their merge rank to active ones as Orbs of Fear, so the deck wants several of them and only some of them placed well.
abilities: When on a tile bordering the path, the Banshee activates and starts periodically dealing damage to monsters around her.
When Banshees are inactive, they periodically lose their merge rank and give an Orb of Fear to a random active Banshee. Each Orb of Fear increases the damage inflicted.

When using the mana ability, all Banshees on the battlefield will start shrieking, inflicting damage to all monsters on the battlefield, while bosses and mini bosses become barred from using their abilities for 2 sec. The effect is used once per every Shriek's duration.
notes: Damage type is venom.
Impervious to stunning and paralyzing effects, and to boosts and debuffs affecting the attack interval.

entries.name: Bard
entries.summary: Has two modes rather than a normal Mana Power-up, shared across every Bard: attack with ricocheting shots, or stop attacking and bank Inspiration to hit far harder later.
abilities: Instead of classic Mana Power-up, this unit has two modes toggled by using the Mana Power-up button. The mode is shared by all Bards.
In Attack mode, Bards attack the first target; the projectile then ricochets to a different random monster several times.

In the Music mode, Bards are spending mana to accumulate Inspiration, increasing the Inspiration level, and do not attack. The Bard's damage increases in proportion to the Inspiration levels accumulated. Also in the Music mode, Bards make monsters more vulnerable to their attacks.
notes: When the amount of mana falls to 100% of the summoning cost, the process of accumulating Inspiration slows down by a factor of 20.
After Inspiration level 300, the damage bonus is reduced to 0.25%. After Inspiration level 1000, it is reduced to 0.1%.

The Fandom wiki unit page (revision 2026-01-06) lists these base figures, before talents, reincarnation or level bonuses: base damage 930, attack interval 0.5s, inspiration cooldown 0.53s, hero cooldown 4%, 3 ricochets, armour destruction 2% rising to a 30% cap. Not yet checked in-game.

entries.name: Blade Dancer

abilities: The Blade Dancer attacks the first target on the path. If there are no nearby Dancers, enters a boosted mode, gaining a bonus to attack speed. The damage increases for each Dancer on the field.
When attacking, has a 1% chance to summon a tornado that moves toward monsters and deals 350% of the Dancer's attack damage.
notes: The maximum damage bonus is attained with seven Blade Dancers present.

entries.name: Blazey
entries.summary: Burns your own units down for Coal, flares into stronger forms, and spreads the flame to other Blazeys. Cannot rank up normally — only by merging or the mana power-up.
abilities: Blazey can burn down units of her rank and below (except other Blazeys), reducing their rank and accumulating Coal charges. Every 2 Coal charges, the unit flares up, temporarily changing her form (there are two, Burning and Flaming), which makes the unit stronger and passes the flame to other Blazeys around.

Blazey in the Burning form: deals +30% damage, gains +10% attack speed and an additional attack with an expanded radius that deals 50% damage in an area around the target. When 4 or more Blazeys are present, the extra attack's damage is doubled.
In the Flaming form: damage and speed bonuses are doubled.
Mana power-up extinguishes all Blazeys, increases the rank of one random Blazey, and gives 1 rank to a random Blazey for every 5 extinguished Blazey.
notes: Blazey only ranks up by merging (for example with a Dryad) or by using the mana power-up.
Extinguishing gives Ash for each Blazey extinguished, in proportion to merge rank. Each Ash charge increases the damage of all Blazeys by 2%.

When the enraged state ends, cannot attack or become enraged again for 3 seconds.
notes: In Co-Op mode, becomes enraged regardless of the number of monsters on the battlefield.
